The existing laws and jurisprudence support this Department's view. The act of the local chief executive in issuing the subject Memorandum Circular dated 04 May 2009 is in consonance witn Section 32 of the Local Government Code ('Code') which provides that: "Section 32. City and Municipal Supervision over Their Respective Barangays. - The city or concerned, shall exercise general supervision over component barangays to ensure that said barangays act within the scope of their prescribed powers and functions. ' Thus, it is very explicit that the supervision referred thereto is a general supervision over the component barangays.
